summary: Quote on NSE cash across a dropped socket: the feed reconnects with the same query and subscribes again; the first frame after it reports 0 for every price, and what that frame turns into shows whether the held prices outlived the connection.

notes: The first frame is the web test's FEED with OpenRate 445.5; the frame after the reconnect is worked here: no trade yet on the new connection, every price 0 and the quantities as sent.

deviations.reason: The desktop forgets the held prices when the socket reconnects (FivepaisaFeed::on_connected clears the snapshots), so the first frame after a reconnect that reports 0 for a price goes out as 0.0, ltp included; the web keeps the snapshot across a reconnect (_on_open and _on_close leave last_snapshot) and holds the last price. A zero LTP from a frame without a trade is invented data (rules.md). Desktop defect, or lead decision if the per-connection reset is to stay with the zeros left out instead.

The web's Quote sends 5paisa's best bid (BidRate); the desktop's common carrier has no best bid or ask. Carrier gap (audit C06, lane wire).
The web's Quote sends 5paisa's best bid quantity (BidQty); the desktop's common carrier has no best bid or ask. Carrier gap (audit C06, lane wire).
The web's Quote sends 5paisa's best ask (OffRate); the desktop's common carrier has no best bid or ask. Carrier gap (audit C06, lane wire).
The web's Quote sends 5paisa's best ask quantity (OffQty); the desktop's common carrier has no best bid or ask. Carrier gap (audit C06, lane wire).

The desktop sends price_change on an equity or a future (ltp less the previous close: feed/dialect/names.rs gives 5paisa instrument_change); the 5paisa web adapter sends ChgPcnt as percent_change only, which the desktop sends too. Follows the web adapter in Phase B: 5paisa's dialect entry without instrument_change.

The desktop sends price_change_percent (5paisa's ChgPcnt) on an equity or a future beside percent_change (feed/dialect/names.rs gives 5paisa instrument_change); the 5paisa web adapter sends percent_change only. Follows the web adapter in Phase B: 5paisa's dialect entry without instrument_change.
